composites.name: lj-nve-demo
composites.description: Tiny LAMMPS Lennard-Jones NVE demo: 27 atoms on a simple-cubic lattice, integrated with `fix nve`. Emits temperature, potential_energy, kinetic_energy, total_energy, pressure, and volume each step.

interval.description: Process interval in LJ time units. The bridge issues `run N` calls sized to fit this window.

lattice_density.description: Reduced density of the simple-cubic lattice used to seed atoms.

initial_temperature.description: Reduced temperature used by `velocity all create` for initial Maxwell-Boltzmann sampling.

composites.name: lj-box-model
composites.description: Model-plugin seam demo: the general `LammpsModelProcess` driving the registered `lj-box` LennardJonesBox plugin. Same tiny LJ NVE box as lj-nve-demo, but built through the model seam instead of a hand-written input script. Emits temperature and the three energies each step.

interval.description: Process interval in LJ time units. The process issues `run N` calls sized to fit this window.

lattice_size.description: Lattice replications per side; the box holds lattice_size**3 atoms.

lattice_density.description: Reduced density of the simple-cubic lattice used to seed atoms.

initial_temperature.description: Reduced temperature for initial Maxwell-Boltzmann sampling.

composites.name: lj-nve-demo-with-viz
composites.description: LAMMPS LJ NVE demo with a wired Visualization Step. Each update produces a Plotly HTML figure of the running thermodynamic trajectories, written to the 'viz_html' store.

interval.description: Process interval in LJ time units.

lattice_density.description: Reduced density of the simple-cubic lattice used to seed atoms.

initial_temperature.description: Reduced temperature used by `velocity all create`.

viz_title.description: Title displayed at the top of the Plotly figure.
